name: edit
description: Make precise, anchored edits to a file. Supports 'str_replace' (exact string substitution), 'create' (new file), or 'overwrite' (whole-file rewrite). Prefer 'str_replace' to minimize edit blast radius and prevent truncation.

path.description: File path relative to workspace root.

action.description: Edit action: 'str_replace' (default, replaces exact old_string with new_string), 'create' (create new file), or 'overwrite' (full rewrite).

old_string.description: Exact target substring to replace. Must match exactly once unless replace_all is true. If it matches nowhere exactly, a match that differs only in smart quotes, Unicode dashes or spaces, or trailing whitespace is used when there is exactly one.

content.description: Full file content for 'create' or 'overwrite' actions.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence of old_string instead of requiring exactly one (for renames). Defaults to false.
